role: pure research recommendation, never normal MPC permit or network actuator

required_parameters.cost_spec: Actual sealed Gateway CostSpec, with cost-token estimator identity
required_parameters.prefill_overhead_s: Required nonnegative coefficient; no qualified default
required_parameters.prefill_s_per_token: Required nonnegative physical-token coefficient; no qualified default
required_parameters.prefill_source: Explicit TRAIN fit artifact or clearly labeled experimental assumption
required_parameters.prefill_identified: False unless separately identified; never implies calibration acceptance
required_parameters.cells: Exact physical-prompt/max-output cells: pclass, physical_prompt_tokens, cost_prompt_tokens, max_tokens, TRAIN empirical train_outputs
required_parameters.max_prefill_ktokens: Explicit supported total admitted prefill physical prompt kilo-tokens
required_parameters.provenance: Required decode_source, eos_source, observer_sha256, training_source_sha256, train_cutoff

identity: SHA256 of NativeModel.spec(): own source SHA256, parameters, provenance, cost fingerprint, rules; NOT frozen CPU ModelParameters.identity
forecast: Past-offer source, receipt-clock domain and observed_through; ordered low/mean/high rates and model-cell workmix. No future arrival tape accepted by choose_plan.
scenarios: Three equal-weight deterministic joint quadrature scenarios, pairing rates with conditional TRAIN EOS quartiles .25/.5/.75. Floor(rate*5) equally spaced offers and deficit-balanced workmix. Scenario tuples generated once and shared across all plans.
plans: All eight sequences of three 1-second actions in {16,32}; fixed16 continuation from t=3
score: Mean modeled completed count satisfying BOTH TTFT<=0.5s AND request-mean TPOT<=0.05s. TPOT=(terminal-first)/(sampled EOS-1); one-token EOS has TPOT=0 by convention. Rejected offers earn zero. Research benchmark conditions frozen before benchmarking, not customer SLO claims or inter-token P99.
old_request_score: Old completions count once per rollout when scheduled arrival and first time are known (or first can still be forecast from output=0). Future prefill can spoil their mean TPOT. Missing old scheduled arrival/unknown already-emitted first excludes good credit conservatively, but never excludes interference. Overlapping receding-horizon prediction scores must NOT be summed as benchmark counts; the runner counts actual offered cohorts once.
tie_break: Keep current first action, then fewer cap changes including initial transition, then lexicographic
lifecycle: FIFO full prefill overhead plus physical tokens times coefficient; parallel decode mu=1000/(theta0+thetaD*D+thetaP*Pk). First token after prefill. Release original charged cost once on modeled EOS; R+c<=budget admission; lower cap never evicts.
end_effects: All plans include identical offered continuation through t=5, then full drain until at most t=35. Incomplete drain invalidates search, never earns partial completion reward. This is not an infinite-horizon/stability guarantee.
fallback: 16 on stale/incomplete/unknown physical work or conditional EOS support, unsupported simulated physics, invalid/nonfinite inputs, undrained rollouts or deadline. This is a recommendation, not an eviction or safety guarantee.
deadline: 100ms cooperative wall clock across validation and all plans. Any observed overrun returns fallback; Python/OS preemption can delay return beyond 100ms.
limits: TRAIN provenance is caller-supplied, not cryptographically verified by model construction
ServingObservation must originate from receipt-qualified join_observations; it does not retain all raw native timestamps
Unknown output/prompt or native waiting work falls back, rather than substituting charged-cost tokens as physical work
Unknown old prefill progress conservatively restarts the full work; computed_tokens is unused
Total admitted prefill Pk and ready-first-token D approximate native running-phase features
FIFO prefill, joint quadrature, empirical EOS survival and stationary workmix are approximations
Assumes modeled EOS implies successful completion; no transport lag, failures, KV stalls or asynchronous terminal receipt delay
No native comparison, action-ranking acceptance, calibration acceptance or soft-SLO/stability performance claim
